answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the quartz of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the meadow.
